content: Use servo_control when controlling a servo motor. Parameters: pin, angle between 0 and 180.
Use pin_write to set digital output on a pin. Parameters: pin, value (0 or 1). Use action 'on' for HIGH (1) or 'off' for LOW (0).
Use sensor_stream to continuously read sensor values from a GPIO pin. Parameters: pin.
Use schema_delete to stop control on a pin and free the resource. Parameters: pin.
